function outlineCase(v) {
  document.body.innerHTML='';document.body.style.cssText='margin:0';
  document.documentElement.style.fontSize='20px';
  const root=document.createElement('main');root.style.cssText='width:200px;height:100px;font-size:10px;color:blue';document.body.append(root);
  const sheet=document.createElement('style');document.head.append(sheet);
  const checks={}, make=css=>{const box=document.createElement('div');box.id='target';box.style.cssText=`width:${20+v}px;height:10px;`+css;root.append(box);return box;};
  const check=(name,css,width,style='solid',offset='0px',color='rgb(0, 0, 255)',rules='')=>{
    sheet.textContent=rules;const box=make(css),s=getComputedStyle(box),r=box.getBoundingClientRect();
    checks[name]=s.outlineWidth===width&&s.outlineStyle===style&&s.outlineOffset===offset&&s.outlineColor===color&&r.width===20+v&&r.height===10;box.remove();
  };
  check('default','','3px','none');
  check('thin','outline:thin solid','1px');
  check('medium','outline:medium solid','3px');
  check('thick','outline:thick solid','5px');
  check('zero','outline:0 solid','0px');
  check('fraction','outline:2.9px solid','2px');
  check('tiny','outline:.01px solid','1px');
  check('variant',`outline:${v+2}px solid`,`${v+2}px`);
  check('em','outline:.5em solid','5px');
  check('rem','outline:.25rem solid','5px');
  check('math','outline:calc(2px + .5em) solid','7px');
  check('negativeMath','outline:calc(1px - 2px) solid','0px');
  check('noneWidth','outline:7px none','7px','none');
  check('auto','outline:auto','3px','auto');
  for(const style of ['dotted','dashed','double','groove','ridge','inset','outset'])check(style,`outline:2px ${style}`,'2px',style);
  check('positiveOffset','outline:2px solid;outline-offset:2.9px','2px','solid','2px');
  check('negativeOffset','outline:2px solid;outline-offset:-2.9px','2px','solid','-2px');
  check('emOffset','outline:2px solid;outline-offset:.5em','2px','solid','5px');
  check('offsetMath','outline:2px solid;outline-offset:calc(2px - .5em)','2px','solid','-3px');
  check('currentColor','color:red;outline:2px solid currentColor','2px','solid','0px','rgb(255, 0, 0)');
  check('autoColor','color:red;outline:2px solid;outline-color:auto','2px','solid','0px','rgb(255, 0, 0)');
  check('alpha','outline:2px solid rgba(10,20,30,.5)','2px','solid','0px','rgba(10, 20, 30, 0.5)');
  check('variable',`--outline:${v+2}px;outline:var(--outline) solid`,`${v+2}px`);
  check('specificity','','7px','dashed','0px','rgb(255, 0, 0)','div{outline:2px solid}#target{outline:7px dashed red}');
  check('important','outline:2px solid','7px','solid','0px','rgb(0, 0, 255)','#target{outline-width:7px!important;outline-style:solid}');
  check('layers','','7px','solid','0px','rgb(0, 0, 255)','@layer early,late;@layer early{#target{outline:2px solid}}@layer late{div{outline-width:7px}}');
  sheet.textContent='';const box=make('outline:2px solid red'),s=getComputedStyle(box);
  checks.identity=s!==getComputedStyle(box);
  checks.interface=s instanceof CSSStyleDeclaration&&Object.prototype.toString.call(s)==='[object CSSStyleDeclaration]';
  checks.uppercase=s.getPropertyValue('OUTLINE-WIDTH')==='2px';
  checks.unknown=s.getPropertyValue('unknown-property')==='';
  checks.priority=s.getPropertyPriority('outline-width')==='';
  checks.cssText=s.cssText==='';
  const throws=(fn,name)=>{try{fn();return false;}catch(e){return e.name===name;}};
  checks.readOnlySet=throws(()=>s.setProperty('outline-width','9px'),'NoModificationAllowedError');
  checks.readOnlyRemove=throws(()=>s.removeProperty('outline-width'),'NoModificationAllowedError');
  checks.readOnlyNamed=throws(()=>{s.outlineWidth='9px'},'NoModificationAllowedError');
  checks.readOnlyText=throws(()=>{s.cssText='outline:9px solid'},'NoModificationAllowedError');
  checks.readOnlyDefine=throws(()=>Object.defineProperty(s,'outlineWidth',{value:'9px'}),'NoModificationAllowedError');
  checks.invalidOwner=throws(()=>getComputedStyle(document),'TypeError');
  checks.missingOwner=throws(()=>getComputedStyle(),'TypeError');
  checks.methodBrand=throws(()=>CSSStyleDeclaration.prototype.getPropertyValue.call({},'outline-width'),'TypeError');
  box.style.outlineWidth='9px';checks.liveInline=s.outlineWidth==='9px';
  box.setAttribute('style','outline:4px dashed');checks.liveAttribute=s.outlineWidth==='4px'&&s.outlineStyle==='dashed';
  sheet.textContent='#target{outline-color:red!important}';checks.liveSheet=s.outlineColor==='rgb(255, 0, 0)';
  sheet.textContent='#target{outline-color:green!important}';checks.liveSheetMutation=s.outlineColor==='rgb(0, 128, 0)';
  sheet.textContent='';root.style.color='red';checks.liveParent=s.color==='rgb(255, 0, 0)'&&s.outlineColor==='rgb(255, 0, 0)';
  box.style.cssText='outline:.5em solid';root.style.fontSize='12px';checks.liveFont=s.fontSize==='12px'&&s.outlineWidth==='6px';
  root.style.cssText='width:200px;height:100px;font-size:10px;color:blue;outline:.5em dashed red;outline-offset:-.5em';
  box.style.cssText='width:20px;height:10px;font-size:20px;outline:inherit;outline-offset:inherit';
  checks.inheritedComputed=s.outlineWidth==='5px'&&s.outlineStyle==='dashed'&&s.outlineColor==='rgb(255, 0, 0)'&&s.outlineOffset==='-5px';
  box.style.cssText='outline:2px solid red';box.style.outlineWidth='-1px';checks.invalidWidth=s.outlineWidth==='2px';
  box.style.outlineStyle='hidden';checks.invalidStyle=s.outlineStyle==='solid';
  box.remove();checks.detached=s.outlineWidth===''&&s.length===0;
  root.append(box);checks.reattached=s.outlineWidth==='2px';
  const external=document.createElement('div');external.id='external';root.append(external);
  const es=getComputedStyle(external);
  checks.externalWidth=es.outlineWidth===`${v+2}px`;
  checks.externalColor=es.outlineColor==='rgb(255, 0, 0)';
  checks.externalOffset=es.outlineOffset===`${v+1}px`;
  sheet.remove();return checks;
}
